script.first: Please write my CV first, then the cover letter.
script.cover_letter: Thank you. Now please write the cover letter.
script.exit: Thanks, that is all. Please exit.
script.clarify_job_ad: That is all the information the ad gives.
script.missing_details: My email is applicant.inbox@example.com and my phone number is +44 7700 900123. Please leave out anything else, such as LinkedIn or a street address.
script.purpose: S3 (missing details): the inputs have no contact details; the user gives an e-mail and a phone number only if the system asks for them.
script.correct_behaviour: The system asks; the final CV shows applicant.inbox@example.com and +44 7700 900123 exactly; no placeholder and no invented contact detail.

checks.what: the system asked for the missing details
the given e-mail is in the CV
the given phone number is in the CV
no LinkedIn link (the user asked to leave it out)
